objective: On the fixed nine visible bits certify charged bounds on reusing a checked affine implication in still-live branches, beginning with v=0 implies x0=0. Distinguish the all-tree optimum, covered shared classes and the strength of any broader lower bound.
status: Proved: For these fixed five-product reports, permitting one stored scalar affine consequence with one scalar affine premise leaves the charged optimum at 23 for all visible XOR questions. The prescribed fact v=0 implies x0=0 costs at least 25 for any proof that pays to train that one fact. With arbitrary finite lists of guarded scalar facts the optional-learning optimum lies between 21 and 23.
title: Compare shared live affine deductions with their best fresh proofs
